developmentBacklogAdded.title: Fixed-price scope risk estimator
developmentBacklogAdded.reason: Estimate likely hours and hidden scope from fixed-price WordPress/WooCommerce listings before ranking them. This prevents superficially attractive 70–100 USD projects from outranking safer work when the brief implies full redesign, payment, shipping, performance and post-launch support.

developmentBacklogAdded.title: Restriction-first freelance filter
developmentBacklogAdded.reason: Extract country, language, timezone and applicant-eligibility restrictions before deeper scoring on freelance boards. This avoids wasting verification effort on USA-only, Spanish-only or otherwise ineligible Worldwide-looking listings and improves source-yield analytics.
